settings.question: How do I know where my order is?
settings.answer: When your order ships we email you the tracking number. You can also find it in your account order history, or on our order tracking page.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Delivery time depends on the product and your address. You will see it on each product page and in our shipping policy.

settings.question: How much is shipping?
settings.answer: The exact cost is calculated at checkout based on your address, before you pay.

settings.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: You can see every available method at checkout and at the bottom of this page. Payments are processed by Shopify's secure checkout.

settings.question: Is it safe to shop here?
settings.answer: Yes. Payment happens in Shopify's encrypted checkout; we never see or store your card details.

settings.question: Can I return a product?
settings.answer: See time limits and conditions in our refund policy.

settings.question: Can I use a discount code?
settings.answer: Yes. Enter it in the cart or at checkout, in the "Discount code" field.

settings.question: Do I need an account to buy?
settings.answer: No, you can check out as a guest. With an account you can see your order history and save your addresses.

settings.question: How can I contact you?
settings.answer: Message us through our contact page and include your order number if you have already purchased.

settings.title: Can't find your answer?
settings.text: Send us a message and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
